messages:
ashley: AM quick pulse — doing a short async standup for embed-cache launch prep.
ashley: did: finalized routing/spec note for prefix caching, posted PR #842 for review, ran perf bench on dev rig (p50 ~72ms).
ashley: blocker: e2e embed-cache flaky in CI (timeout in cache_sync). need someone to triage failing logs.
ashley: today: triage CI, finish launch checklist edits, confirm canary config + fallback policy.

mike: taking PR #842 review now, will push a small patch for the header serialization. @ashley can you paste the CI trace link?

sofia: saw the e2e failure — looks like a race on cache flush when seq length hits 512, reproducer below:
```
pytest tests/e2e/test_embed_cache.py::test_persist --maxfail=1 -k cache_sync
# fails intermittently with TimeoutError on cache_sync.acquire()
```
sofia: I'll try to repro locally and add a deterministic sleep in the harness to see if it's a timing issue.

jordan: I can take a look at the pipeline — I'll add a quick retry wrapper on the test step to reduce noise (retry=3) and file an infra ticket if it still flakes.

kai: FYI I updated the public launch checklist doc with a few items (data retention, monitoring alerts, canary thresholds): https://redwood.app/handbook/launch-checklists/embed-cache
kai: also added a note to confirm fallback model variant mapping and SLA doc.

mike: I can own fallback variants and rollback runbook. Will draft a short runbook and add CB thresholds + rollback commands.

ashley: for canary we should wait for the runner metrics before final signoff. deploy-bot: Canary job 1769998889 finished — token success 98%, p50 latency 78ms, errors <0.1%. :white_check_mark:

sofia: filed a small issue for a function-calling output regression seen in edge-case tests, issue #559. Not blocking unless function-call tests regress across canary.

jordan: quick ask to reviewers — please prioritize PRs >24h: #838, #842, #849. Adding them to the review queue now. :pray:

ashley: thanks team. If CI triage completes and PRs get reviewed by EOD, we'll greenlight the next-week schedule. I'll loop in eng-oncall if we need an emergency rollback plan. :rocket:

mike: ping @sofia for the test fix, I'll prepare the runbook fragment and link it to the checklist.

ashley: closing this thread — post any urgent updates here. :thumbsup:
